summary: This Phase 4 clinical trial studies different combinations of the study drugs pioglitazone and empagliflozin in adults who have type 2 diabetes and fatty liver disease. The study aims to see how well these treatments work by looking at blood sugar control and changes in liver fat scores over 24 weeks. Seoul National University Bundang Hospital is sponsoring the research, which plans to enroll 120 participants and is currently Recruiting.
